# CodePipelineProcessToolUse

One tool call an agent made during a code pipeline run: its input, its result and how long it took.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `stepExecutionId` | `uuid` | The `id` of the step (in the run's `phases`) the call belongs to. |
| `phaseName` | `string` | The name of the phase the call belongs to. |
| `agentName` | `string` | The name of the agent that made the call. |
| `stepName` | `string` | The name of the step the call belongs to. |
| `sequence` | `integer` | The call's position in the step's transcript. Tool calls and transcript entries share one numbering, so sorting both by it gives the order things happened in. |
| `timestamp` | `datetime` | When the agent made the call, in UTC. |
| `toolName` | `string` | The name of the tool called. |
| `toolUseId` | `string \| null` | The coding tool's own id for the call. Null for coding tools that don't give one. |
| `input` | [`NameValuePair`](name-value-pair.md)`[]` | The call's input, as name-value pairs. Complex values are given as text. |
| `result` | `string \| null` | What the tool returned. Null until the result arrives. |
| `inputOriginalBytes` | `integer` | The size of the input's values as the agent sent them, in UTF-8 bytes, before any shortening. |
| `resultOriginalBytes` | `integer` | The size of the result as the tool returned it, in UTF-8 bytes, before any shortening. |
| `isTruncated` | `boolean` | Whether the input or result was shortened because it was extremely large. Rare. |
| `duration` | `timespan \| null` | How long the call took. Null when unknown. |
| `codePipelineProcessId` | `uuid` | The id of the code pipeline run it belongs to. |
| `rev` | `integer` | Its revision, which goes up each time it changes (a tool result arriving after its call, for example). Starts at 1. Compare it with the `rev` in the run's references to tell whether your copy is current. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |
